sgtconti_clouds_background.name: Clouds Background
sgtconti_clouds_background.description: Procedural drifting cloud background with four cloud types (cumulus, altostratus, cirrus, cumulonimbus) and adjustable density, scale, wind, sky tint and opacity. Supports WebGL and WebGPU.

cloudType.name: Cloud type
cloudType.desc: 0 = cumulus (broken puffs), 1 = altostratus (flat grey overcast sheet), 2 = cirrus (thin high wisps), 3 = cumulonimbus (tall storm mass). Other parameters apply to whichever type is selected.

density.name: Density
density.desc: Cloud coverage. Lower values produce separated cloud patches. For altostratus the sheet always covers the sky, so this sets how much light passes through it instead.

cloudScale.name: Scale
cloudScale.desc: Cloud feature scale. Higher values make the cloud pattern change size clearly.

speedX.name: Wind X
speedX.desc: Horizontal drift speed in pixels per second.

speedY.name: Wind Y
speedY.desc: Vertical drift speed in pixels per second.

skyTint.name: Sky tint
skyTint.desc: How much the sky gradient tints the clouds.

skyTop.name: Sky top color
skyTop.desc: Top color of the sky gradient.

skyBottom.name: Sky bottom color
skyBottom.desc: Bottom color of the sky gradient.

mask.name: Only on transparent
mask.desc: 0 = full rectangle. 100 = render only where the layer/object is transparent.

horizon.name: Horizon
horizon.desc: Perspective toward a horizon line. 0 keeps the flat field. Higher values compress the clouds toward the horizon, spread them from the view centre, slow distant drift and add haze.

horizonY.name: Horizon line
horizonY.desc: Where the horizon sits, as a percentage down the view. 100 is the bottom edge. Only has an effect when Horizon is above 0.
